content: Regen Network / Invest in high-integrity carbon credits Regen Registry catalyzes ecological regeneration by empowering the people doing it Regen Registry is a blockchain-powered ecological projects and data registry that empowers communities to register, verify, and manage environmental initiatives to provide an accessible and trusted path to finance ecosystem regeneration.our credit protocolsPioneering new pathways for people to engage in ecological regenerationRegen Registry offers tools to track regenerative initiatives and engage in project finance. Regen Registry registration and verification of conservation and regeneration projects following approved protocols and methodologies and issues credits on a transparent registry system.Create protocols for project financeDefine and document diverse approaches to track and reward ecological value creation.Register projects and issue creditsLeverage data-driven tools to register projects, measure impact, create claims, and issue credits.Participate in registry governanceEngage in community-driven processes to guide platform development and innovate on new solutions governed by regenerators.learn about the registryRegen Registry is the ecological project registry of the futureRegen Registry redefines how stakeholders participate in regenerative ecological claims and contracting by providing the tools necessary to progressively unlock funding to protect and preserve your land and culture. Our approach fosters collaboration while supporting needs of this emerging field through interoperability, and integrity, and transparency. We empower communities to define their own approach to ecological regeneration Our flexible toolkit makes the process of engaging in ecological regeneration easier by allowing communities to engage early in the process, and progressively develop solutions that reflect their unique ecological contexts and values. We provide an interoperable framework that fosters collaboration in the industryOur comprehensive framework of common languages and data standards supports interoperability between different ecological initiatives, tools and platforms to reduces fragmentation and encourage co-creation.We leverage blockchain technology to enhance integrity of environmental assetsOur technology provides an immutable record of ecological data, claims, and agreements to fosters trust and enable data-driven decision-making. name: regen-foundation
title: Regen Foundation
description: Regen Foundation supports diverse communities with ideas and technologies which integrate ecological, economic, and human well-being.
content: Regen Foundation We catalyze grassroots institutions for ecosystem regeneration and resilience.Our work seeds new models for community-led governance, ownership, and sensing using digital public infrastructure.As a non-profit, your support builds the next generation of protocols for a more plural and interdependent future.Explore our work ↓ Initiatives Regenerative Institutions on Regen Ledger We bolster locally-grounded ecological economies by co-designing and deploying grassroots governance systems on Regen Ledger. Prototyping Commons Through our microgrant accelerator, we enable communities to prototype DAOs that are hybrid commons of living ecosystems and data. Ecological Institutions A framework to expand the legibility of the more-than-human world; from inert resources to living institutions leveraging digital protocols of ownership, governance, and sensing. Community Staking DAO We allocate $REGEN governance tokens to diverse stakeholders, embedding equity and shared authority within the digital infrastructure that supports ecological regeneration. Publications Our body of original thinking which entangles living and information systems and guides our practices in the world. African Mutualism Our exploration of African Mutualism connects traditional communal systems and knowledge to today's commons, revealing enduring legacies of shared governance and collective resource stewardship. Covenants Agreements and contracts with grassroots and indigenous organizations acting as containers to explore the ethical integration of technology, economics, and law in service to life and interdependence. Our Community The bioregions, events, and communities we grow with! Regen Builder Lab Roll up your sleeves every month with a community of builders developing the projects and technologies which propel the new regenerative economy. News June 12th, 2025 Online Blockchain@UBC - "Living Covenants and Protocols of Interdependence" presented by Austin Wade Smith July 14 to 20, 2025 Stockholm, Sweden “Network Nations” at Emergent Lakefront Stockholm May 18th to 19th Seattle, WA, USA BioFi Cascadia “Living Covenants in Theory and Practice” presented by Austin Wade SmithMay 12, 2025 New York, USA R3.0 Biogregional Governance Roundtable Core patterns and concepts of bioregional governance presented by Austin Wade SmithMay 6, 2025 New York, USA Presentation for UN Science Technology and Innovation Forum May 6, 2025 Citation Stanford Social Innovation Review “The Next Generation of Mutualism” by Sara HorowitzApril 2025 Stanford CodeX: Collaborative AI and IP Alliance February 2025 Denver, USA EthDenver Models for Collective Impact AccountingFebruary 2025 Citation Blockchain x Climate Digital Carbon Market Report "Regen Network Governance Report"February 2025 Global Challenges Action Innovation Partnership at United Nations Partnership Forum 2025 "Global Challenges Action Day" (GCAD) initiative and the Data and Digital Innovation Consortium Sign up for our newsletter Submit Thank you for signing up! Support In 2025… while the traditional climate financial industry is basically collapsing, we are deploying a multi-scalar approach, raising 2 million dollars to develop a series of ground-breaking proof of concepts for what a regenerative future might look like.We are reaching out to our network to ask if you are anyone you know resonates with this theory and this practice... We ask you to consider making a tax deductible donation to the Regen Foundation this year.Every little bit helps! Now is the time. Donate Team Austin Wade Smith Executive Director Austin Wade Smith (they/them) is an artist, ecologist, writer, and technologist based in Brooklyn, New York. They are the Executive Director of the Regen Foundation, a non-profit researching sovereign regenerative economies. Their research explores the interrelation of mutualism, animism, and bioregionalism in decentralized technical and economic infrastructures. Previously, they taught critical methodologies on climate justice in art and engineering at universities in New York. They enjoy cultivating orchids, and flying kites. Shaila Agha Ecosystem Development Program Officer Shaila is a trusted intermediary and environmental advocate working at the convergence of Finance, ecology, and indigenous knowledge systems. With a background in Economics and disruptive Fintech, she focuses on regenerative models of economic justice, data sovereignty, and cultural resilience. Her work ranges from regenerative, non-monetary systems such as blockchain-based community currencies in Kenya, to teaching Syntropic Agroforestry and researching the intersection of Finance and African Mutualism. She is a certified Data Protection Officer and an internationally exhibited installation artist, which reflects her broader commitment to cultural conservation, environmental justice, and systemic transformation. Whether through policy, soil, or story, her focus is on building futures that are equitable, interconnected, and rooted in community. Nena Jain Programs Manager Nena Jain implements bold and complex ideas through designing operational infrastructures, communications, and knowledge systems that support the growth of regenerative movements. Driven by curiosity, she connects complex ideas across disciplines. Her background includes work in Sexual and Reproductive Health and the Fair Trade supply chain sector. Born and raised in Southern India near the Bay of Bengal, she is now based in Vienna. There, she co-stewards a community-led art atelier where she practices sculpting as an animist expression, and hosts a monthly supper club with friends. Will Szal President of the Board Will was a member of the co-founding team of Regen Network in the summer of 2017. He is co-founder of Origins Co-op, a confederated regenerative commodity brokerage, and currently serves as a Board Member and Treasurer at Terra Genesis International PBC, as well as a Steering Board Member at Redesigning for Resilience and Regeneration. Will lives in rural New England, and is passionate about the domains of regenerative agriculture, alternative and gift economics, phenomenology, animism, and myth. He is a citizen of the Connecticut River watershed, and his new endeavor, Hyperbeings, is an ontological framework to see bioregional-scale entities, such as watersheds, from an animist perspective. Amanda Joy Ravenhill Board Member Amanda Joy Ravenhill is Executive Director of the Buckminster Fuller Institute and an active member of the international community focused on addressing imminent global challenges. She previously held the role of Co-Founder and Executive Director of Project Drawdown, a comprehensive plan to reverse global warming. Ravenhill is driven by her experience living and working internationally as well as her enthusiasm to integrate art and science. She is the Executive Director of Buckminster Fuller Institute. Dorn Cox Board Member Dr. Dorn Cox, PhD, is the Research Director for the Wolfe’s Neck Center for Agriculture and the Environment, and Founder of FarmOS and the Farm Hack community. Dr. Cox was recognized in 2018 by the National Association of Conservation Districts with the inaugural Hugh Hammond Bennet award for excellence in conservation. Active in the U.S. Soil Health movement, he speaks regularly nationally and internationally about participatory science, open agricultural knowledge exchange, soil health, and regenerative agriculture. He is passionate about the potential for open source agriculture to accelerate innovation and quantify environmental services. Kei Kreutler Board Member Kei Kreutler is a researcher, writer, and artist interested in how cultural narratives of technologies shape their use. Previously, she worked at Gnosis, building decentralized infrastructure for cryptonetworks, and in 2021, she co-created Gnosis Guild, a small team behind the Zodiac open software standard for interoperable and modular organizational governance tools. She is currently developing a book project on memory as a way of seeing technology, ecology, and economics. Contact Are you interested in exploring partnerships and collaborations? title: DeSci Labs – Empowering Researchers from Data to Publication
description: DeSci Labs helps researchers manage, store and publish data with AI-powered insights and workflows to boost chances of publishing in top journals.
content: DeSci Labs – Empowering Researchers from Data to Publication Log inSign upAccelerating Scientific ProgressDeSci Labs builds solutions that make research faster, accessible, and more transparent - powered by AI and designed for the future of science.Discover our solutionsFeatured In"DeSci Labs is redefining how researchers manage and publish their work, offering an all-in-one solution with features like AI-powered insights and blockchain-verified attestations for research validation."Nature, December 2024Our ExpertiseSciWeaveAI Research AssistantAsk questions and get research-backed insights in seconds - complete with citations and related papers. Perfect for students, scientists, and professionals.Trusted, academic insightsSciWeave sources every response from academic literature, so you know the answers are based on real science - not speculation or secondhand summaries.Accelerate your workflowInstead of scanning Google Scholar, reading dozens of abstracts, or skimming PDFs, you get structured insights in seconds.Cut through the noiseWhether you're conducting background research, drafting a paper, or planning an experiment, SciWeave surfaces related research and themes you might otherwise miss.Quickly get to the rootEvery answer includes a references section, so you can trace claims directly to their sources.Get started for freeLearn moreDeSci PublishAll-in-One Preprint NetworkShare, version, and curate your manuscripts, data, and code - all in one place. No fees, no barriers, just open science made easy.Manuscripts, Data, Code - All in One PlaceBring all your research outputs together in one convenient place.Enhance transparency, ensure easy access for collaborators, and update your work effortlessly as your research evolves—maximizing impact over time.Increase your Publication ChancesTransparency is key. Share your data and code openly to stand out with colleagues, editors, and reviewers. Build trust and credibility by showcasing the foundation of your results.Stand Out with Validated BadgesClaiming a badge on DeSci Publish starts a peer review process and opens a public dialogue with your referees. Once validated, badges credibly highlight your contributions - even before your work gets published in a journal.Get a DOI and ORCID CreditGet DOIs for manuscripts, data, and code, ensuring all your research outputs are properly indexed in the scholarly record. For ORCID users, contributions are automatically added to each co-author’s profile—giving you full credit for all your work.Get started for freeLearn moreDeSci Reviewer FinderPeer Review Reviewer FinderReviewer matching tool built for journal editors and funding agencies. Instantly surface the most qualified, conflict-free referees, and see why they are suggested.AI that understands manuscriptsOur AI calculates research papers’ content and context novelty scores, helping you quickly assess how original a manuscript is compared to existing literature.Save time and reduce editorial workloadInstantly generate expert reviewer suggestions, cut hours of manual searching, and focus on content and decision-making.Automatic conflict of interest checksOur algorithm analyzes each submission, identifies key references, and recommends conflict-free reviewers based on authorship of closely related, recent peer-reviewed papersSeamless integration with your workflowUse Reviewer Finder alongside your existing editorial systems.
